page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured within the ecs.g7se server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The instance features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent performance under load.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7se.16xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads that require dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of hyperthreading. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance type well-suited for general-purpose applications, medium-sized databases, application servers, containerized microservices, and continuous integration pipelines that demand predictable compute performance and moderate memory capacity.
